_README: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 16 rules implemented by the Non Linear Dynamic Bot's tool. Each item names the clause it
implements and the pdf page of the user's converted ASCE 7-22 (converted/ASCE7, printed pages 187-190) that was
read to confirm it. `verified: true` here means: read against that converted text on 2026-09-04. The wording is
paraphrased, not quoted -- spec text never leaves the Query file manager computer.

target_spectrum.rule: Method 1: single target = MCE_R spectrum = 1.5 x design response spectrum (5% damped)

n_motions.rule: not less than 11 ground motions, each a pair of orthogonal horizontal components; same tectonic regime, consistent M and R, similar spectral shape

period_range.rule: upper bound >= 2 x largest first-mode period (>= 1.5x if justified by MCE_R dynamic analysis); lower bound includes the modes giving 90% mass participation each direction and <= 0.2 x smallest first-mode period

amplitude_scaling.rule: maximum-direction spectrum per pair; identical factor on both components; suite average generally matches or exceeds target and is not below 90% of target at any period in the range

spectral_matching.rule: if matched: suite average >= 110% of target over the range (not used by this tool)

orientation.rule: non-near-fault: pairs applied at orthogonal orientations so the mean component spectrum applied in each direction is within +-10% of the mean of all components over the period range

modeling.rule: 3-D model; hysteretic behaviour consistent with ASCE 41 or test data; strength/stiffness degradation included unless shown not to occur

gravity.rule: 1.0D + 0.5L with L = 80% of unreduced live > 100 psf, else 40% of unreduced live; also 1.0D alone unless the exception (0.5L sum <= 25% D and L0 < 100 psf over >= 75% of area) applies

p_delta.rule: P-delta with the spatial distribution of gravity loads included

torsion.rule: inherent eccentricity; accidental 5% eccentricity only where a Type 1 horizontal irregularity exists

damping.rule: hysteretic dissipation modelled directly; additional viscous damping <= 2.5% in significant modes

results_basis.rule: mean of story drift and element demand Qu used; if one unacceptable motion is permitted, use 120% of median but not less than the mean of the acceptable ones

unacceptable_response.rule: non-convergence; deformation-controlled demand beyond valid modelling range; critical/ordinary force-controlled demand beyond capacity; peak transient story drift > 150% of the permissible mean; residual drift > 0.015 hsx for > 240 ft. Exception: RC I/II without spectral matching -> at most ONE motion may be unacceptable

transient_drift.rule: mean transient story drift <= 2 x Table 12.12-1 limit; for hn > 100 ft also <= hsx(4.71e-2 - 7.14e-5 hn) with hn in ft, not less than 0.03 hn; computed at the structure's edges within one analysis

table_12_12_1_all_other.note: Table 12.12-1 'all other structures' row by Risk Category; RC III/IV values transcribed from ASCE 7-22 Table 12.12-1 -- RE-VERIFY through Query file manager before use in a deliverable

residual_drift.rule: for > 240 ft: mean residual story drift <= 0.01 hsx

force_controlled.rule: (1.2 + 0.12 SMS) D + 0.5 L + 1.3 Ie (Qu - Qns) <= phi B Rn and (0.9 - 0.12 SMS) D + 1.3 Ie (Qu - Qns) <= phi B Rn; phi per material standard (critical), 0.9 (ordinary), 1.0 (noncritical); B = 1.0 or 0.9 Rne/Rn

deformation_controlled.rule: valid range of modelling per the material standard, else ASCE 41 maximum deformation parameter; may be extended if strength and stiffness degrade to negligible values

gravity_system.rule: elements not in the SFRS shown to carry gravity at the mean building displacements

linear_analysis.rule: a Chapter 12 linear analysis is ALSO required (the Steltic package is that analysis); rho may be 1.0, Omega0 may be 1.0, drift limits of 12.12.1 need not apply for RC I-III

design_review.rule: independent structural design review; at least one reviewer a registered design professional

component_models.note: hinge / brace backbones come from steltic_pushover/hinge_params.json (ASCE 41 -> AISC 342 placeholders, UNVERIFIED). Cyclic deterioration is OFF (Lambda = 0) in this prototype -- 16.3.1 requires degradation unless shown not to govern; flagged in the report.
